## Hinge question · Which factors do we need? {#dc1-hinge .dc-lesson}

<div data-module="hinge" data-correct="3" class="hinge numeric-choices">
<p class="hinge-question">For <span data-math="y=3^{2x+1}"></span>, which expression is <span data-math="\frac{dy}{dx}"></span>?</p>
<div class="hinge-toolbar"><div class="time" role="timer" aria-label="Time remaining">1:00</div><div class="toolbar"><label>Seconds <select class="timer-duration" aria-label="Question duration"><option>30</option><option>45</option><option selected>60</option><option>90</option><option>120</option></select></label><button class="timer-start primary">Start</button><button class="reset-question">Reset</button></div></div>
<div class="choices">
<button class="choice" data-answer="1" aria-pressed="false"><b>1</b><span data-math="(\ln3)3^{2x+1}"></span></button>
<button class="choice" data-answer="2" aria-pressed="false"><b>2</b><span data-math="2\cdot3^{2x+1}"></span></button>
<button class="choice" data-answer="3" aria-pressed="false"><b>3</b><span data-math="2(\ln3)3^{2x+1}"></span></button>
<button class="choice" data-answer="4" aria-pressed="false"><b>4</b><span data-math="(2x+1)3^{2x}"></span></button>
</div>
<div class="hinge-bottom"><p>Fist on chest. Think quietly.<br>On “show”, hold up 1–4 fingers.</p><button class="reveal-answer primary">Reveal answer</button></div>
<div class="hinge-explanation" hidden><strong>3.</strong> <span data-math="\ln3"></span> comes from the base; <span data-math="2"></span> comes from differentiating the exponent.</div>
</div>

::: notes
Additional diagnostic, not a booklet example. Numbered options 1–4 correspond to A–D in the approved plan; correct answer 3 (C). The constant base is 3 and the inner derivative is 2. Distractor 1 omits the chain-rule factor. Distractor 2 treats base 3 like base e and omits ln3. Distractor 4 incorrectly applies the power rule to a variable exponent. Default 60 seconds. Everyone keeps a fist on their chest and thinks independently; collect simultaneous 1–4 responses on the teacher's “show” cue. Timer expiry never reveals the answer. Ready: proceed to Example 1.6. Divided: pairs explain where each factor comes from, then revote. Needs explanation: rewrite 3^(2x+1)=e^((2x+1)ln3), differentiate the exponent explicitly, then retry. Allow around three minutes including discussion.
:::
